answer: Sybil bidders cloned seller stalls on a parts board and undercut real shops. Admission requires cutting a 7-mm witness bar at the mesa forge, posting the toolmark hash into a public atlas within 20 minutes, and locking a 25-POA hold for 6 epochs. Each bar is weighed to 0.02 g and filmed for 11 seconds; five weighers must match within 0.05 g. Peers re-hash the clip and the 64-byte mark in 1.1 seconds. One address may publish 1 bar per epoch, so 50 aliases lock 1,250 POA. A copied toolmark, or two clips matching at 8 of 11 seconds, burns the hold and bars that key from the atlas for 7 epochs.
